candidate_construction: Copy of published 92ac mirror, with only walk/js/city-context.js replaced by the approved patch; that runtime file and other listed runtime modules match 3f81 exactly.
frame_scope: One desktop 1280x800 Full-detail session, actual 1871 app, three poses and three confidence states, each with an old-depth fallback negative control.
shadow_readback: 512x512 texel-center native PCF depth-texture comparison samples at reference depth 0.99999. Counts/hashes measure occupied-shadow coverage, not recovered floating-point depth values. Off-state occupancy hashes are identical; dither has fewer occupied samples; hidden coverage is zero.
shader_evidence: depth-14 and depth-15 are actual patched bridge and instanced caster GPU shaders; depth-17 and depth-18 are the native unpatched negative controls. All compile and link; per-frame uniform readbacks are in report.json.
limitations: Focused software-rendered native shadow acceptance; no hardware FPS or GPU-memory measurement.
Does not replace complete city, other-year, source, or CI gates. Earlier complete city acceptance continues to cover unchanged geometry, terrain, floor support, lighting, and dates.
Generic context buildings, trees and bridge forms remain an explicitly approximate baseline; this is not photographic or individually identified historical reconstruction.

Adding test_city_context_depth.mjs changes check.sh step ordinals and partition assignment. Old source-gate receipts remain bound to their old source revisions; supplemental/new gates must be recorded separately.
